Slinger (Animal)
Slinger, Spear Cat, Night Slinger, Hell Slinger

While most Saber Cats attack with melee weapons, others have become fond of harassing their enemies with javelins or by throwing potions. They rarely retreat and generally attack in large, well-organized groups, as is evident in their use of ranged weapons. They are quick to the chase and enjoy the hunt, so encountering a pack of these predators is dangerous, at best.

Tips and Other Additional Information
Take care of these quickly or run away. Slingers are one of the most annoying monsters in the game, especially Night Slingers who throw Poison potions.

Slingers and Spear Cats have a chance to deal Cold damage in Nightmare and Hell.
Hell Slingers have a chance to deal Fire damage in Nightmare and Hell.
